**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 of the Brightline agreement matches our preferred ASSIGN position on every material term:

- **24.1** — Customer (Northwind) may assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets **without Vendor consent**; only prompt written notice and assignee assumption are required.
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments run through a mutual "not unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed" standard.
- **24.4** — Expressly negates any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control, and requires cooperation with successor administrative changes.

Cross-checks confirmed no back-door vendor exit: Section 9 termination triggers contain no change-of-control or assignment hook (9.2 is insolvency-only and carves out lawful reorganizations that do not impair performance), and Section 13 lets us transfer licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with a Section 24 permitted assignment.
